description: A satellite, rocket stage or piece of debris by NORAD number (25544), international designator (1998-067A) or name. Answers `record` (GCAT: owner, country, maker, launch and reentry dates, mass, orbit, status), `tle` (latest elements from SatNOGS) and `position` (where it is over the Earth now: lat, lon, altitude km, speed, period, and how old the elements are), or `matches` for a designator or name.

query.description: NORAD number, designator or name, e.g. 25544

name: satellite_lookup
title: Satellite Lookup
